LMoP|sildar hallwinter.title: Sildar Hallwinter
LMoP|sildar hallwinter.intro: Sildar Hallwinter was a retired knight from Neverwinter and later a member of the Town Council of Phandalin in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|sildar hallwinter.physical: Sildar was nearly 50 years old in 1491 DR.
LMoP|sildar hallwinter.personality: Despite his restrained and almost cold mannerisms and speech, Sildar was kind-hearted and sincere, although lacking in confidence and charisma. He was generally risk-averse, although still willing to enter into potentially dangerous situations when no one else dared. He wished to see the town of Phandalin prosper and to ensure that innocents—even fools—never came to any harm.

LMoP|gundren rockseeker.title: Gundren Rockseeker
LMoP|gundren rockseeker.intro: Gundren Rockseeker was a dwarf treasure hunter and one of the three Rockseeker brothers who rediscovered Wave Echo Cave in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|gundren rockseeker.personality: Gundren was an eager treasure hunter, willing even to travel the planes in search of wealth. After discovering Wave Echo Cave, he was excited and secretive about the find, and was impatient to return and excavate the discovery. He was gracious to those who helped him.

LMoP|klarg.title: Klarg
LMoP|klarg.intro: Klarg was a lieutenant of King Grol of the Cragmaw tribe during the late 15th century DR. He was in command of the Cragmaw Hideout, an outpost of the Cragmaw tribe in the 1491 DR.

LMoP|iarno albrek.title: Iarno Albrek
LMoP|iarno albrek.intro: Iarno Albrek, also known as "Glasstaff", was a human wizard and the leader of the Redbrands bandit gang.
LMoP|iarno albrek.physical: He was a short, dark-bearded human wizard that was simply known to most as "Glasstaff" for his weapon of choice, a magic staff made of glass, which was a staff of defense. Iarno was initially a member of the Lords' Alliance, who was sent to the town of Phandalin to establish constabulary (as the town did not have a powerful authority). Albrek had a rat familiar that served as a scout.

LMoP|toblen stonehill.title: Toblen Stonehill
LMoP|toblen stonehill.intro: Toblen Stonehill was the proprietor of the Stonehill Inn in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|toblen stonehill.physical: Toblen was a young man who was quite short and very friendly. His inn served drinks and food, and offered rooms for rent, and Toblen himself was always happy to pass on gossip he'd heard in his common room.

LMoP|linene graywind.title: Linene Graywind
LMoP|linene graywind.intro: Linene Graywind was the master of the Lionshield Coster trading post in Phandalin in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|linene graywind.personality: She was described to be sharp-tongued. She worked tirelessly to keep her business running smoothly regardless of whether times were good or bad, and was grateful to anyone that could aid her in times of need. She was a reliable source for gossip.

LMoP|halia thornton.title: Halia Thornton
LMoP|halia thornton.intro: Halia Thornton was a Zhentarim agent and the original guildmaster of the Phandalin Miner's Exchange in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|halia thornton.physical: Thornton was a calculating agent with huge ambitions. She wished to further the Zhentarim cause by taking over Phandalin and adding it to their territory. Thornton wished to do this by slowly establishing her guild as the governing body of the village.
LMoP|halia thornton.personality: She was a fierce but patient woman who was dangerous to cross. She had few qualms about helping those who seemed like valuable business partners, and equally few qualms about stabbing those same people in the back if it suited her (or even if they were simply rude to her).

LMoP|reidoth.title: Reidoth
LMoP|reidoth.intro: Reidoth was a druid who spent much time in the village of Thundertree and was a member of the Emerald Enclave in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|reidoth.physical: The druid had long white hair, and was lean and haggard. She was said to know a lot about the land and locations in the nearby area. She did not receive many adventurers, and was rather tight-lipped.

LMoP|agatha.title: Agatha
LMoP|agatha.intro: Agatha, also known as the Ghost of Neverwinter Wood, was a banshee who haunted the Neverwinter Wood near Conyberry.
LMoP|agatha.physical: The banshee looked like she did in life: an elven maiden clad in a flowing gown. She was dead, though, her skin shriveled, and eyes staring pale and blind, but those eyes, while empty, saw all things.
LMoP|agatha.personality: Never powerless, Agatha still retained the wizardry skills she had in life. She was seen throughout the Dessarin river region, but she avoided interactions with others, especially when she believed a powerful wizard was in the area. Agatha viewed the townsfolk of Conyberry as allies and would use her powers to bring food and protection to the community during harsh winters, including killing orcs or raiders who ventured too near the village.

LMoP|bowgentle.title: Bowgentle
LMoP|bowgentle.intro: Bowgentle of Silverymoon was a legendary wizard.
LMoP|bowgentle.personality: Bowgentle was noted for his calm demeanour, politeness and generosity, but also for his reckless adventuring.

LMoP|grista.title: Grista
LMoP|grista.intro: Grista Kettlecopp was a dwarf who lived in Phandalin in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|grista.physical: Grista owned and ran the Sleeping Giant taproom. She did not keep the pub clean, and it attracted the ruffians of Phandalin, like the Redbrands.
LMoP|grista.personality: She was described to be bad-tempered, rude, and unpleasant. She valued being left alone to run her business the way she saw fit, and had no desire to get involved with anyone else's personal business.

LMoP|harbin wester.title: Harbin Wester
LMoP|harbin wester.intro: Harbin Wester was the Townmaster of Phandalin and subsequently a member of the Town Council of Phandalin in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|harbin wester.physical: Harbin was a corpulent middle-aged banker and politician. He was the wealthiest resident of Phandalin and its biggest landowner, and he tended to dress in clothes that communicated his wealth.
LMoP|harbin wester.personality: Harbin was pompous and pretentious. He generally presented himself as polite and friendly, if a bit overdramatic and effusive, but this was just for politics. In fact, he was a greedy, calculating, and two-faced businessman at heart, unafraid to push the boundaries of decency or legality to get what he wanted.

LMoP|mosk.title: Mosk
LMoP|mosk.intro: Mosk was a bugbear who worked for Nezznar circa 1491 DR and led the goblinoids under his employ.
LMoP|mosk.physical: The bugbear leader more a jeweled leather eyepatch just for aesthetics, instead of practical purposes, as he had both eyes intact. He also carried 33 sp. Mosk led the goblinoids that worked towards the Black Spider's cause.

LMoP|aldith tresendar.title: Aldith Tresendar
LMoP|aldith tresendar.intro: Aldith Tresendar, also known as the Black Hawk, was a knight of great repute in the 10th century DR.

LMoP|urmon.title: Urmon
LMoP|urmon.intro: Urmon was an adventurer and lore enthusiast.
LMoP|urmon.physical: Urmon kept a journal where they noted down the history of the Lost Mine of Phandelver, and the Forge of Spells. Their journal also recorded that an enchanted mace called Lightbringer, which was made in the mine for a cleric of Lathander.

LMoP|tsernoth.title: Tsernoth
LMoP|tsernoth.intro: Tsernoth was a necromancer that inhabited Iriaebor.

LMoP|venomfang.title: Venomfang
LMoP|venomfang.intro: Venomfang was a green dragon who made its lair in an old wizard's tower in the ruins of Thundertree village.
LMoP|venomfang.physical: The appearance of Venomfang. Venomfang was a typical young green dragon. Not wanting to give up its amassed wealth, the dragon was protective of its base.

LMoP|palien.title: Palien
LMoP|palien.intro: Palien was a warrior and a hero, who was celebrated for fending off several groups of monsters during the founding of Thundertree.

LMoP|favric.title: Favric
LMoP|favric.occupation: Leader of a band of Cultists of the Dragon
LMoP|favric.intro: Favric was the local group leader of the Cult of the Dragon in Thundertree circa 1491 DR.
LMoP|favric.physical: Favric dressed in the typical garb of a dragon cultist, wearing a long dark robe and a black leather mask. He could speak Draconic, as well as Common. The young leader was far more ambitious than others of his sect.

LMoP|gog.title: Gog
LMoP|gog.home: Wyvern Tor, the Sword Coast North
LMoP|gog.intro: Gog was an ogre who allied himself with a group of scouts from the Many-Arrows tribe.
LMoP|gog.physical: The filthy ogre was fearless in combat, and would fight until he was slain.

LMoP|vhalak.title: Vhalak
LMoP|vhalak.intro: Vhalak was a doppelganger in the employ of Nezznar, the Black Spider.
LMoP|vhalak.physical: A servant of the Black Spider, Vhalak often took the form of a drow male, who supervised others.

LMoP|elmar barthen.title: Elmar Barthen
LMoP|elmar barthen.intro: Elmina Barthen was the proprietor of Barthen's Provisions, the largest trading post in Phandalin, in the late 15th century DR.

LMoP|daran edermath.title: Daran Edermath
LMoP|daran edermath.intro: Daran Edermath was a retired drow or half-elf adventurer who dwelt in Phandalin in the late 15th century DR.
LMoP|daran edermath.physical: Daran had silver hair and was over a hundred years old. He was a retired member of the Order of the Gauntlet, but still kept in touch with them. His connections secretly made him one of the most powerful folk in Phandalin, if he cared to bring them to bear.
LMoP|daran edermath.personality: Daran was quick to help, and was happy to speak and trade with newcomers to the town of Phandalin, sometimes offering them a place to stay in his apple orchard. However, he was slow to put his faith in strangers, and any hint of underhandedness could forever lose his trust. He preferred to avoid politics.

LMoP|qelline alderleaf.title: Qelline Alderleaf
LMoP|qelline alderleaf.intro: Qelline Alderleaf was a halfling farmer that lived in Phandalin.
LMoP|qelline alderleaf.physical: The farmer was very knowledgeable about the ongoings of the village she lived in. She was also said to be wise and practical. Qelline was kind enough to let adventurers stay in the hayloft of her home free of charge.

HotDQ|frulam mondath.title: Frulam Mondath
HotDQ|frulam mondath.intro: Frulam Mondath was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin, holding the rank of Wearer of the Purple.

HotDQ|langdedrosa cyanwrath.title: Langdedrosa Cyanwrath
HotDQ|langdedrosa cyanwrath.intro: Langdedrosa Cyanwrath was a half–blue dragon member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon.
HotDQ|langdedrosa cyanwrath.physical: Cyanwrath was seven feet tall with bright blue scales. He had draconic features and sharp claws.
HotDQ|langdedrosa cyanwrath.personality: While the half-dragon had a strong sense of honor, he could be driven to wrathful rage.

HotDQ|azbara jos.title: Azbara Jos
HotDQ|azbara jos.intro: Azbara Jos was a Red Wizard of Thay and a member of the faction loyal to Rath Modar.

HotDQ|jamna gleamsilver.title: Jamna Gleamsilver
HotDQ|jamna gleamsilver.intro: Jamna Gleamsilver was a gnome assassin and a member of the Zhentarim.

HotDQ|pharblex spattergoo.title: Pharblex Spattergoo
HotDQ|pharblex spattergoo.home: Castle Naerytar, Mere of Dead Men
HotDQ|pharblex spattergoo.intro: Pharblex Spattergoo was the chief and shaman of the bullywug tribe in the Mere of Dead Men during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489.
HotDQ|pharblex spattergoo.personality: Pharblex greatly enjoyed tormenting the lizardfolk, thanks to Dralmorrer Borngray putting them under his control, and he killed the lizardfolk chief Suncaller.

HotDQ|talis the white.title: Talis the White
HotDQ|talis the white.intro: Talis Kasterel, or Talis the White, was a high-ranking member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin in the late 15th century DR.
HotDQ|talis the white.personality: Talis was a devoted follower of Tiamat and a traditionalist of the faith. She believed that Severin's methods deviated too much from their true objective and he just wanted glory for himself. She also greatly despised not being chosen as White Dragon Whisperer, a title that went instead to Varramzord.

HotDQ|rezmir.title: Rezmir
HotDQ|rezmir.home: Castle Naerytar, Mere of Dead Men
HotDQ|rezmir.intro: Rezmir, or Rezmir the Black, was a half–black dragon human woman who was the Black Dragon Wyrmspeaker of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin. She descended from House Orogoth.
HotDQ|rezmir.personality: She was a fierce and terrible warrior, relentless and cruel with her enemies, even if they existed among her own ranks. She was truly devoted to Tiamat.

HotDQ|rath modar.title: Rath Modar
HotDQ|rath modar.intro: Rath Modar was a Red Wizard of Thay who had desires to become the next Zulkir of Illusion and even grander plans for himself.
HotDQ|rath modar.personality: Rath was deceptive and obfuscating. He had an interest in ancient empires and lost items of power. He plotted revenge from his castle on the Sword Coast.

HotDQ|blagothkus.title: Blagothkus
HotDQ|blagothkus.intro: Blagothkus was the cloud giant ruler of Skyreach Castle.
HotDQ|blagothkus.personality: Blagothkus was a survivor of the giant empires of the past, and his main dream was to somehow go back to those glorious times. Using this motivation, the Cult of the Dragon convinced him that they were reestablishing a time when only giants and dragons would rule, though his commitment to that alliance was borne more out of a desire to spur giant-kind to action.

HotDQ|severin silrajin.title: Severin Silrajin
HotDQ|severin silrajin.intro: Severin Silrajin, usually known simply as Severin, was the Red Dragon Wyrmspeaker and the main leader of the reformed Cult of the Dragon in the late 15th century DR.
HotDQ|severin silrajin.personality: Severin was a true visionary, bringing new life and power to the Cult. However, he was also young and prone to underestimating his enemies or not seeing enemies posing as friends.

HotDQ|leosin erlanthar.title: Leosin Erlanthar
HotDQ|leosin erlanthar.intro: Leosin Erlanthar was a monk from Berdusk, the master of Nesim Waladra. and a member of the Harpers who researched the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin during the late 1480s DR.

HotDQ|ackyn selebon.title: Ackyn Selebon
HotDQ|ackyn selebon.intro: Ackyn Selebon was a merchant of Baldur's Gate during the Tyranny of Dragons.

HotDQ|ardred briferhew.title: Ardred Briferhew
HotDQ|ardred briferhew.intro: Ardred Briferhew was a veteran caravan master just before the Tyranny of Dragons.

HotDQ|larion keenblade.title: Larion Keenblade
HotDQ|larion keenblade.intro: Larion Keenblade was a member of Severin's reformed Cult of the Dragon.

HotDQ|dralmorrer borngray.title: Dralmorrer Borngray
HotDQ|dralmorrer borngray.home: Castle Naerytar, Mere of Dead Men
HotDQ|dralmorrer borngray.intro: Dralmorrer Borngray was an elf who served as caretaker of Castle Naerytar for the Black Dragon Wyrmspeaker Rezmir of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin. He was also member of the Eldreth Veluuthra.
HotDQ|dralmorrer borngray.personality: Borngray idolized Rezmir and followed all her orders and did all he could to help her. The only exception was Rezmir's pact with the bullywugs; Borngray considered the lizardfolk to be more reliable and did what he could to benefit the lizardfolk and spite the bullywugs. He was also impatient for the arrival of Tiamat and the doom of humanity so he could go to more civilized places like Evermeet.

HotDQ|varram.title: Varram
HotDQ|varram.intro: Varramzord, also known as Varram the White, was a male gold dwarf and the White Dragon Wyrmspeaker in the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin.
HotDQ|varram.personality: Owing to his past experience, Varram hated the Red Wizards of Thay and despised the fact that Severin had allied with them. Varram was one of Severin's best friends, but had a weak personality and greatly feared the wrath of Severin. He could be easily convinced to betray the Cult in exchange for his personal protection.

HotDQ|maelgot.title: Maelgot
HotDQ|maelgot.intro: Maelgot was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin.

HotDQ|kusphia.title: Kusphia
HotDQ|kusphia.intro: Kusphia was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin.

HotDQ|wigluf.title: Wigluf
HotDQ|wigluf.intro: Wigluf was a stone giant who helped Blagothkus in managing the flying Skyreach Castle.
HotDQ|wigluf.personality: Wigluf was very concerned about Blagothkus' plan to ally with dragons and the Cult of the Dragon. He was scared that the consequences for giant kind would be terrible, but he supported Blagothkus out of loyalty.

HotDQ|sandesyl morgia.title: Sandesyl Morgia
HotDQ|sandesyl morgia.intro: Sandesyl Morgia was a vampire and member of the Cult of the Dragon as of the late 15th century DR.
HotDQ|sandesyl morgia.personality: She was a true believer of the "true path" as taught by Sammaster, the founder of the Cult of the Dragon and former chosen of the goddess Mystra.

HotDQ|achreny ulyeltin.title: Achreny Ulyeltin
HotDQ|achreny ulyeltin.intro: Achreny Ulyeltin was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|achreny ulyeltin.personality: Achreny was a boorish man without trace of civilization about him. He was smelly, vulgar, and utterly without manners.

HotDQ|aldor urnpoleshurst.title: Aldor Urnpoleshurst
HotDQ|aldor urnpoleshurst.intro: Aldor Urnpoleshurst was a lawyer just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|aldor urnpoleshurst.personality: Aldor was very suspicious of others and made accusations over nothing. He was a lawyer in training but a skunk in inclination.

HotDQ|beyd sechepol.title: Beyd Sechepol
HotDQ|beyd sechepol.intro: Beyd Sechepol was a merchant during the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|beyd sechepol.personality: Beyd was a very diplomatic individual, always evading arguments that divided public opinion, with the exception of topics regarding horses and gear.

HotDQ|eldkin agetul.title: Eldkin Agetul
HotDQ|eldkin agetul.intro: Eldkin Agetul was a guard just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|eldkin agetul.personality: Eldkin was a perfectionist and wanted all to know this.

HotDQ|enom tobun.title: Enom Tobun
HotDQ|enom tobun.intro: Enom Tobun was a teamster just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|enom tobun.personality: Enom loved telling stories, not caring for the truthfulness of them. If someone question this, he grew resentful and vindictive. On the other hand, he was a wonderful traveling companion.

HotDQ|green imsa.title: Green Imsa
HotDQ|green imsa.intro: Green Imsa was a traveler just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|green imsa.personality: Imsa was a quiet and friendly individual. She became frustrated if people bothered her about her condition.

HotDQ|lai angesstun.title: Lai Angesstun
HotDQ|lai angesstun.intro: Lai Angesstun was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|lai angesstun.personality: Lai was fixated with money. He talked only about how much he would make, how he spent it, and how others would envy him. He was selfish and never used his money to help someone else.

HotDQ|leda widris.title: Leda Widris
HotDQ|leda widris.intro: Leda Widris was a mercenary just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|leda widris.personality: Leda was an honest and courageous woman. She wanted to experience what a real cold wind felt like.

HotDQ|losvius longnose.title: Losvius Longnose
HotDQ|losvius longnose.intro: Losvius Longnose was a teamster on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|losvius longnose.personality: Losvius's surname derived not from his big nose but from his overpowering thirst for gossip about other people. Losvius was fixated on uncovering others' embarrassing secrets.

HotDQ|noohar serelim.title: Noohar Serelim
HotDQ|noohar serelim.intro: Noohar Serelim was a merchant that operated on the Sword Coast as of the late 15th century DR.
HotDQ|noohar serelim.personality: Noohar was one of the most articulate persons in Faerun. He was a fantastic orator and talked non-stop, even though he seldom had something to say.

HotDQ|nyerhite verther.title: Nyerhite Verther
HotDQ|nyerhite verther.intro: Nyerhite Verther was a Calishite silk merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|nyerhite verther.personality: The merchant was not a scrupulous individual. When unhinged, he exploded in anger and fury.

HotDQ|orvustia esseren.title: Orvustia Esseren
HotDQ|orvustia esseren.intro: Orvustia Esseren was a guard on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons in the late 15th century DR.
HotDQ|orvustia esseren.personality: The guard was smart, tough, and talented with her bow and spear but knew nothing of the Realms outside her homeland.

HotDQ|tyjit skesh.title: Tyjit Skesh
HotDQ|tyjit skesh.intro: Tyjit Skesh was a guard on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons.
HotDQ|tyjit skesh.personality: Tyjit was quick to anger and quicker to use her two blades, but was also honest to a fault. She did not tolerate bullying, and always explained the cause of her anger in the hopes that people's attitude would change.

RoT|neronvain.title: Neronvain
RoT|neronvain.intro: Neronvain was the Green Wyrmspeaker of the reformed Cult of the Dragon that attacked the Misty Forest during the late 1480s DR.

RoT|naergoth bladelord.title: Naergoth Bladelord
RoT|naergoth bladelord.race: Human, later wight or Death knight
RoT|naergoth bladelord.intro: Naergoth Bladelord was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon. He was the warrior lord of the cult and the leader of the ruling council. He usually resided in Saerloon.

RoT|rath modar.title: Rath Modar
RoT|rath modar.intro: Rath Modar was a Red Wizard of Thay who had desires to become the next Zulkir of Illusion and even grander plans for himself.
RoT|rath modar.personality: Rath was deceptive and obfuscating. He had an interest in ancient empires and lost items of power. He plotted revenge from his castle on the Sword Coast.

RoT|tiamat.title: Tiamat
RoT|tiamat.intro: Tiamat () was the chaotic evil and lawful evil dragon goddess of greed, queen of evil dragons and, for a time, reluctant servant of the greater gods Bane and later Asmodeus. Before entering the Faerûnian pantheon, she was a member of the Draconic pantheon, and for some time she was also a member of the Untheric pantheon.
RoT|tiamat.physical: Tiamat's humanoid avatar form. Tiamat was a unique chromatic dragon, who had one head for each primary color of the most common species of chromatics (black, blue, green, red, white). Each head was able to operate entirely independently of each other and had the powers of a member of the respective race of dragonkind.
RoT|tiamat.personality: Tiamat was arrogant, greedy, hateful, spiteful and vain. She never forgave any kind of slight and was focused on obtaining more power and wealth. She disdained mortals, regarding them as mere disposable tools in her schemes.

RoT|cheela flegsteel.title: Cheela Flegsteel
RoT|cheela flegsteel.intro: Cheela Flegsteel was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon during the late 15th century DR.

RoT|yggran.title: Yggran
RoT|yggran.intro: Yggran was a half-red dragon agent of the Cult of the Dragon active during the late 15th century DR..

RoT|cylanestriel.title: Cylanestriel
RoT|cylanestriel.intro: Cylanestriel was an elven ranger and celebrated hero that ventured the Realms circa the late 15th century DR.

RoT|bel.title: Bel
RoT|bel.intro: Bel was an archdevil of the Nine Hells who acted as the Archduke of Avernus until he was supplanted by Zariel. He was a military genius who specialized in misdirection and led with careful tactics, in contrast to his successor's berserker rage.
RoT|bel.physical: Unlike many other archdevils, Bel retained a resemblance to a pit fiend, appearing as a tall, crimson-scaled colossus with massive, bat-like wings, clawed extremities, and fangs that dripped a green, smoking venom. His visage was brutal and bestial but nonetheless infernal, warped by innumerable years of willful wickedness and hatred.
RoT|bel.personality: Calculating and calm in his assessments, Bel was one of the greatest military minds in the Nine Hells, using every tactical advantage available and only engaging in battle on his own terms. His favored tactics involved ambushes, double-crosses, feints and counter-feints, and backstabbing his enemies while anticipating the treacherous moves of his rivals. While he occasionally erupted with anger upon being foiled, he was generally cool-headed—a far cry from the constant, fiery fury of Zariel.

RoT|loska.title: Loska
RoT|loska.intro: Loska was a winter wolf that lived in the North during the late 15th century DR. She was the traveling companion of Delaan Winterhound, a ranger of the Emerald Enclave.

RoT|nymmurh.title: Nymmurh
RoT|nymmurh.intro: Nymmurh was a bronze dragon summoned to the metallic dragon's council to discuss of the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat during the Tyranny of Dragons.
RoT|nymmurh.personality: Nymmurh was sympathetic to humanoids, especially those who chose the path of goodness and justice. He reasoned that metallic dragons were made in Bahamut's image, and therefore had no choice to be good. As such it was all the more reason to celebrate humanoids, who were capable of evil, that freely chose the path of goodness and justice.

RoT|meltharond.title: Meltharond
RoT|meltharond.home: Reghed Glacier, Spine of the World
RoT|meltharond.intro: Meltharond was a once-powerful wizard-ruler and former consort and companion of the white dragon Arveiaturace.

RoT|mend-nets.title: Mend-nets
RoT|mend-nets.intro: Mend-nets was a warrior of the Ice Hunters tribe that made their home on Oyaviggaton during the late 15th century DR.
RoT|mend-nets.personality: He was a rather untrusting individual that held a distinct distaste for the monstrous creatures that laired within his tribe's icy island-home. He detested the kobolds that laired within the isle's cave network, loathed its community of revolting ice toads, and became completely frightened by its ravenous ice troll denizens.

RoT|galin.title: Galin
RoT|galin.intro: Galin was an elf that served as warden of Altand in the Misty Forest in the High Moor as of the late 15th century DR. He unfortunately became entangled in the schemes of the Cult of the Dragon.
RoT|galin.personality: He developed something of an anxious personality due to the numerous burdens set upon his shoulders and secrets he was forced to keep.

RoT|protanther.title: Protanther
RoT|protanther.intro: Protanther was a particularly powerful gold dragon who was once the King of Justice.
RoT|protanther.personality: Protanther did not like the humanoid races. He thought that the humanoids attained too many powers in a very short time without developing the wisdom to use them judiciously. For this reason he believed the humanoid races were dangerous.

RoT|jorgen pawl.title: Jorgen Pawl
RoT|jorgen pawl.intro: Jorgen Pawl was a member of the Cult of the Dragon during the late 15th century DR. He was commander of Xonthal's Tower.

RoT|nyh ilmichh.title: Nyh Ilmichh
RoT|nyh ilmichh.intro: Nyh Ilmichh was an envoy of the Red Wizards of Thay sent by Szass Tam to propose an alliance between Thay and the Council of Waterdeep in the 1490s DR.

PotA|shoalar quanderil.title: Shoalar Quanderil
PotA|shoalar quanderil.intro: Shoalar Quanderil was a high-ranking member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|shoalar quanderil.personality: Shoalar always appeared jovial, but with a biting sense of humor and tending to laugh at people rather than with them. He saw Olhydra's power as a means to become rich.

PotA|hellenrae.title: Hellenrae
PotA|hellenrae.intro: Hellenrae was a high-ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|hellenrae.personality: Hellenrae simply hated everyone, even her fellow cultists, so she tried to avoid contact with others. She greatly despised weakness.

PotA|windharrow.title: Windharrow
PotA|windharrow.intro: Windharrow was a high-ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|windharrow.personality: He was at heart an opportunist. Windharrow was loyal to Aerisi Kalinoth as long as he feared her power. However, confronted with danger to his life or a richer offer, he would betray the air cult without a backward glance.

PotA|aerisi kalinoth.title: Aerisi Kalinoth
PotA|aerisi kalinoth.intro: Aerisi Kalinoth was the Prophet of Air and leader of the Cult of the Howling Hatred.

PotA|gar shatterkeel.title: Gar Shatterkeel
PotA|gar shatterkeel.intro: Gar Shatterkeel was the Prophet of Water and the leader of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the late 15th century DR, until its defeat along with the other cults of Elemental Evil, after which he was saved by the sea goddess Umberlee and served as one of her Chosen.
PotA|gar shatterkeel.physical: His skin was covered in barnacles, and his left arm was replaced by a large mechanical crab claw prostheses. He wielded a magical trident known as Drown while he was the Prophet of the Cult of the Crushing Wave, and then the magical trident Wave while acting as a Chosen of Umberlee.

PotA|miraj vizann.title: Miraj Vizann
PotA|miraj vizann.intro: Miraj Vizann was the second-in-command of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|miraj vizann.personality: Miraj was a very rational and deliberate individual. He joined the earth cult only to deepen his understanding of elemental magic. He believed that enemies could be bribed or persuaded, such as to attack instead fire cultists.

PotA|marlos urnrayle.title: Marlos Urnrayle
PotA|marlos urnrayle.intro: Marlos Urnrayle was the Prophet of Earth and the leader of the Cult of the Black Earth.
PotA|marlos urnrayle.personality: He was genteel and well-spoken, but took pleasure in mocking others and could be driven to fits of blind, unreasoning jealousy.

PotA|vanifer.title: Vanifer
PotA|vanifer.intro: Vanifer was the Prophet of Fire and leader of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in the late 15th century DR.
PotA|vanifer.personality: She was extremely manipulative, gathering allies as she needed them and discarding them as soon as they lost their usefulness. Though she put on the airs of a rich noble, she despised those born into wealth.

PotA|yan-c-bin.title: Yan-C-Bin
PotA|yan-c-bin.intro: Yan-C-Bin (), also known as the Prince of Evil Air, was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Air. He was referred to by a number of names and titles, including the Prince of Evil Aerial Creatures, the Shadow of the Four Winds, and the Howling Hatred
PotA|yan-c-bin.physical: Yan-C-Bin commonly appeared to his followers as a tall, thin, elderly humanoid with long hair flowing in the wind. His true form was akin to a tornado.
PotA|yan-c-bin.personality: Yan-C-Bin was flighty and quick to react to things, but he was also a rational thinker with a desire for intellectual stimulation and a love of scholarly pursuits. It was said that all creatures in the sky of any plane feared Yan-C-Bin. But he also had a strong sense of honor and would generously reward those who helped him.

PotA|olhydra.title: Olhydra
PotA|olhydra.physical: In her natural state, she appeared as a huge cresting wave with two eyes like large pearls or as a shapeless watery mass about in diameter.
PotA|olhydra.personality: Olhydra delighted in creating dangerous and destructive manifestations of water. She was eager to smash any vessel in her realm and destroy any city and town within her reach. She could surge forth tirelessly and relentlessly, but was patient enough to know when to draw back and when to attack, eroding her opponent.

PotA|oreioth.title: Oreioth
PotA|oreioth.intro: Oreioth was a necromancer hiding in Red Larch in the late 15th century DR.
PotA|oreioth.personality: Oreioth had always been cruel, but after his self-exile to Red Larch with only the company of his undead servitors, he became a true megalomaniac. He barely recognized his own name and dreamed of founding a kingdom of undead minions with himself on the throne. He considered himself the "Lord of Lance Rock" and hoped to protect his "kingdom" from invaders.

PotA|vizeran devir.title: Vizeran DeVir
PotA|vizeran devir.intro: Vizeran DeVir was an exiled drow archmage during the late 15th century DR.
PotA|vizeran devir.personality: Vizeran's main objective was revenge against both Gromph and Lolth, the first for what he did to him, and the second for the dominion she maintained over all drow. His plans and goals were entirely self-serving, and he would sacrifice anyone without hesitation to further his schemes.

PotA|larrakh.title: Larrakh
PotA|larrakh.intro: Larrakh was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in Red Larch who was in contact with the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|larrakh.personality: The priest hoped to redeem himself in the eyes of his cultist masters by conquering Red Larch. His plot was to transform the Believers into a nefarious organization and afterward unveil and defeat them, becoming a hero in the eyes of the citizens.

PotA|zomith.title: Zomith
PotA|zomith.intro: Zomith was a half-orc caravan guard during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|grund.title: Grund
PotA|grund.intro: Grund was simpleton in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|grund.personality: Grund was a happy dim-witted sort. He had a special relationship with the members of the Believers.

PotA|umsheryoth.title: Umsheryoth
PotA|umsheryoth.intro: Umsheryoth was an adult male bronze dragon residing in the Dessarin Valley.

PotA|nurvureem.title: Nurvureem
PotA|nurvureem.intro: Nurvureem, also known as the "Dark Lady", was a draa'zekyl shadow dragon with a fell reputation among the inhabitants of the Dessarin River Valley. She maintained several different lairs, though she favored the ruined manor-house of Rundreth Manor.
PotA|nurvureem.personality: As of the 15th century DR took on the persona of enigmatic and beautiful drow woman, referred to by locals as "the Dark Lady". She did not abide disruptive visitors and cared little for those who tried to ingratiate themselves as allies.

PotA|darathra shendrel.title: Darathra Shendrel
PotA|darathra shendrel.intro: Darathra Shendrel was a human knight and the Lord Protector of Triboar in the Dessarin Valley, as well as a former adventurer and a member of the Harpers, in the late 15th century DR.
PotA|darathra shendrel.personality: She was good-natured and had a reputation for fairness and sensible governance. Darathra believed that good people must be allowed to prosper free from tyranny and she was willing to give her life for the people of Triboar. She was resolute and never backed down, and pushed back when pressured.

PotA|gervor.title: Gervor
PotA|gervor.intro: Gervor was an adventurer prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|wulgreda.title: Wulgreda
PotA|wulgreda.intro: Wulgreda was a prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|darreth.title: Darreth
PotA|darreth.intro: Darreth was a commoner of Womford in the Dessarin Valley in the late 15th century DR.

PotA|bruldenthar.title: Bruldenthar
PotA|bruldenthar.intro: Bruldenthar was a dwarven sage in Mirabar during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|teresiel.title: Teresiel
PotA|teresiel.intro: Teresiel was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|rhundorth.title: Rhundorth
PotA|rhundorth.intro: Rhundorth was a master blacksmith in Mirabar who became a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|renwick caradoon.title: Renwick Caradoon
PotA|renwick caradoon.intro: Renwick "Snowcloak" Caradoon was the eldest of the three brothers whose exploits led to the creation of the Knights of Samular (along with Samular Caradoon and Amphail the Just). Renwick eventually died in the last battle of the Second Troll War, only to return as an archlich.

PotA|jurth.title: Jurth
PotA|jurth.intro: Jurth was an orog member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|lytin.title: Lytin
PotA|lytin.intro: Lytin was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Scarlet Moon Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR.

PotA|eyon.title: Eyon
PotA|eyon.intro: Eyon was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|thuluna maah.title: Thuluna Maah
PotA|thuluna maah.intro: Thuluna Maah was a sea hag and a high-ranking member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|thuluna maah.personality: Thuluna Maah was the second-in-command of the temple, answering only to Gar Shatterkeel. She was a sly, calculating creature, quick to offer bargains and make deals that she could later turn to her advantage. Thuluna dreamed of purging the cult of its human members but only when the right opportunity came.

PotA|morbeoth.title: Morbeoth
PotA|morbeoth.intro: Morbeoth was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|morbeoth.personality: Morbeoth was a proud and prickly individual. He felt that his mastery of arcane power put him above anyone weaker. He resented that a mere druid was chosen to serve as the Prophet of Water, and that an ugly monster like a sea hag served as the cult's second-in-command.

PotA|nartham.title: Nartham
PotA|nartham.intro: Nartham was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|nartham.personality: Nartham was a violent and short-tempered fellow, always looking for an excuse to kill.

PotA|yarsha.title: Yarsha
PotA|yarsha.intro: Yarsha was a high-ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|yarsha.personality: Yarsha was a murderous individual, plotting to kill and replace Miraj Vizann.

PotA|xharva deem.title: Xharva Deem
PotA|xharva deem.intro: Xharva Deem was a dao in service to the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|bastian thermandar.title: Bastian Thermandar
PotA|bastian thermandar.intro: Bastian Thermandar was the second-in-command of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar-Besil in the late 1490s DR.
PotA|bastian thermandar.personality: Bastian was a very paranoid individual, not trusting anyone. He was also greatly ambitious, scheming to gain for himself Tinderstrike and supplant Vanifer.

PotA|reetha.title: Reetha
PotA|reetha.intro: Reetha was a bowyer in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|drexa.title: Drexa
PotA|drexa.intro: Drexa was the chieftain of the Blackmaw lizardfolk tribe at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar-Besil and a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|drexa.personality: The lizard king believed that he should be one of the leaders of the Crushing Wave. He dreamed of overthrowing Gar Shatterkeel one day.

PotA|reulek.title: Reulek
PotA|reulek.intro: Reulek was a duergar ghost at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|obratu.title: Obratu
PotA|obratu.home: Shrine of the Tender Oath, Dessarin Valley
PotA|obratu.intro: Obratu was an oni mage at the Shrine of the Tender Oath in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|dirana.title: Dirana
PotA|dirana.intro: Dirana was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|mougra.title: Mougra
PotA|mougra.intro: Mougra was a goblin bandit in Red Larch during the 1490s DR.

PotA|geeraugh.title: Geeraugh
PotA|geeraugh.intro: Geeraugh was a half-ogre bandit in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|braelen hatherhand.title: Braelen Hatherhand
PotA|braelen hatherhand.intro: Braelen Hatherhand was a boy in Red Larch and a son of a member of the Believers in the 1490s DR.

PotA|baragustas harbuckler.title: Baragustas Harbuckler
PotA|baragustas harbuckler.intro: Baragustas Harbuckler was a retired carpenter in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|inglor brathren.title: Inglor Brathren
PotA|inglor brathren.intro: Inglor Brathren was a member of the Zhentarim at Bargewright Inn during the late 15th century DR.

PotA|fennor.title: Fennor
PotA|fennor.intro: Fennor was a berserker and warlord of the Uthgardt Elk tribe during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|fennor.personality: Fennor was a bloodthirsty leader, wanting massacres. However, she respected Javor and if asked by him Fennor could be convinced to abort the raid.

PotA|grumink.title: Grumink
PotA|grumink.home: Shrine of the Tender Oath, Dessarin Valley
PotA|grumink.intro: Grumink the Renegade was a dwarf at the Shrine of the Tender Oath in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|grumink.personality: Grumink was a bloodthirsty and callous individual. He stopped at nothing to get what he wanted. Grumink delighted in building a reputation as a cold-blooded killer, and went out of his way to slay people when doing so might add to his notoriety or attract the attention of the law.

PotA|ghald.title: Ghald
PotA|ghald.intro: Ghald was a four-armed sahuagin and a member of the Kraken Society during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|cavil zaltobar.title: Cavil Zaltobar
PotA|cavil zaltobar.intro: Cavil Zaltobar was a mercenary wizard in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|ariana riverlost.title: Ariana Riverlost
PotA|ariana riverlost.intro: Ariana Riverlost was a wizard member of the Harpers in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis.

PotA|eldras tantur.title: Eldras Tantur
PotA|eldras tantur.intro: Eldras Tantur was the blacksmith of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR.

PotA|endrith vallivoe.title: Endrith Vallivoe
PotA|endrith vallivoe.intro: Endrith Vallivoe was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a contact of the Harpers during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|endrith vallivoe.personality: The shopkeeper was a shy and scuttling little man. He was an attentive watcher and listener and knew most of the village's rumors. He was a friend to the Harpers and was a useful and loyal informant for them.

PotA|haeleeya hanadroum.title: Haeleeya Hanadroum
PotA|haeleeya hanadroum.intro: Haeleeya Hanadroum was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and an Emerald Enclave supporter during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR.

PotA|harburk tuthmarillar.title: Harburk Tuthmarillar
PotA|harburk tuthmarillar.intro: Harburk Tuthmarillar was the constable of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis on 1491 DR.

PotA|imdarr relvaunder.title: Imdarr Relvaunder
PotA|imdarr relvaunder.intro: Imdarr Relvaunder was a priest of Tempus in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|imdarr relvaunder.personality: Imdarr was a stern man, and keenly interested in news, rumors, and visitors.

PotA|kaylessa irkell.title: Kaylessa Irkell
PotA|kaylessa irkell.intro: Kaylessa Irkell was the owner of the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|kaylessa irkell.personality: Kaylessa was the fortyish matriarch of her family and a pleasant, sturdy woman. She was increasingly worried about strange phenomena in Red Larch and brought up her concerns with any likely adventurers who stopped by.

PotA|mangobarl lorren.title: Mangobarl Lorren
PotA|mangobarl lorren.intro: Mangobarl Lorren was the baker of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis. He ran his shop in that village.
PotA|mangobarl lorren.personality: He loved to gossip and knew all kinds of wild tales, few of them true.

PotA|marlandro gaelkur.title: Marlandro Gaelkur
PotA|marlandro gaelkur.intro: Marlandro Gaelkur was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR.

OotA|droki.title: Droki
OotA|droki.intro: Droki was a derro criminal in Gracklstugh during the late 1480s or early 1490s DR.
OotA|droki.personality: Droki hated everyone in general and surfacers in particular. If he met surfacers, he spent all his time insulting and misleading them. If someone took his satchel, Droki would throw an epic tantrum.

OotA|yestabrod.title: Yestabrod
OotA|yestabrod.intro: Yestabrod was a mutant myconid leader of the Circle of Masters in Neverlight Grove in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|zuggtmoy.title: Zuggtmoy
OotA|zuggtmoy.intro: Zuggtmoy () was the Demon Queen of Fungi, but not considered a true patron of fungi. She was merely the embodiment of the death and virulence that fungi represented, and fully willing to subvert the natural order for her own ends. The Lady of Rot and Decay did not use decomposition for the higher purposes of renewal or rebirth, desiring destruction purely for its own sake.
OotA|zuggtmoy.physical: Zuggtmoy was an utterly inhuman being, but could mold herself into roughly humanoid form. One often depicted form was a skeletally-thin humanoid draped and veiled in mycelium and lichen.
OotA|zuggtmoy.personality: Despite technically engaging in the many facets of mortal life, much like her artificial form, this was a soulless parody of such existence. Zuggtmoy was alien in both body and mind, her only desire being to infect living creatures with her spores, turning them into her mindless slaves before they were reduced to naught but rotting and decomposing hosts for her fungi, mushrooms, and molds. Ultimately she sought to become the master of all life, the dominant mind of one great organism melded from all other living things.

OotA|grisha.title: Grisha
OotA|grisha.intro: Grisha was a human cultist of Yeenoghu in the Labyrinth in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|grisha.personality: A strict ruler, Grisha believed he sensed the power of Yeenoghu in all things and that he was behind the cultists being resurrected as ghouls after they died.

OotA|yeenoghu.title: Yeenoghu
OotA|yeenoghu.intro: Yeenoghu ( ) was a demon lord and the chief being worshiped by gnolls. Dedicated only to destruction, the Ruler of Ruin sought the collapse of civilization and he would brutally butcher all that stood between him and his rabid slaughter.
OotA|yeenoghu.physical: Yeenoghu appeared as a gnoll-like creature, tall with a grinning skull-like face and a leering pair of burning emerald or amber eyes atop his seemingly emaciated form. A mangy, yellow crest of fur reached from his head to mid-back, with the only hair on his body being small scabby patches. The rest of his body was pale and gray, his leathery hide contrasting with his taut mane and a crest of blackened spines within it.
OotA|yeenoghu.personality: Yeenoghu's desires were savage in nature, wanting slaughter and destruction above all else. He took great pleasure in inflicting terror and sorrow before his victims' deaths, destroying treasured possessions and crushing their hopes. He despised civilization and if he were to conquer other realms, abyssal or otherwise, he would not attempt to rebuild their former structures.

OotA|juiblex.title: Juiblex
OotA|juiblex.intro: Juiblex ( ) was a demon lord of oozes and shapeless things, a being that exemplified the corruptive nature of the Abyss and that was almost glorious in its unrivaled obscenity. Ridiculed by its peers as "Lord of Nothing", the Faceless Lord was, even to them, a demon as revoltingly vile in body as it was inscrutably aberrant in mind.
OotA|juiblex.physical: The Faceless One, an [[Avatar of Juiblex.]] Juiblex was, in short, disgusting, undoubtedly hideous to demons of all kinds and perhaps the most foul of all demon lords and deities. Its abhorrent aura was as foul as its sickening, shapeless form, a primordial soup of bubbling bile and nauseating fluid bound by a thin epidermis bathed in oil and thick mucus. The amorphous mass was swirled and striated with a hideous mixture of hues, primarily streaks of black and green combined with bilious browns and yellows as well as translucent grays and ambers.

OotA|yuk yuk.title: Yuk Yuk
OotA|yuk yuk.intro: Yuk Yuk was a goblin living in the Silken Paths during the late 1480s or early 1490s DR.
OotA|yuk yuk.personality: He was a thrill-seeking individual. Yuk Yuk was a relatively sociable denizen of the Underdark.

OotA|glabbagool.title: Glabbagool
OotA|glabbagool.intro: Glabbagool was an unusual sentient gelatinous cube in the Oozing Temple sometime in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR.
OotA|glabbagool.personality: The arrival of the demon lord Juiblex in the Underdark somehow granted Glabbagool sentience. It wanted to avoid fighting, however, and was genuinely curious about the world and the people that inhabited it.

OotA|hemeth.title: Hemeth
OotA|hemeth.intro: Hemeth was a duergar arms dealer from Gracklstugh in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|ariana.title: Ariana
OotA|ariana.intro: Ariana was a deep gnome merchant in Gracklstugh in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|kazook pickshine.title: Kazook Pickshine
OotA|kazook pickshine.intro: Kazook Pickshine was a notorious deep gnome alchemist in Blingdenstone in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|pelek.title: Pelek
OotA|pelek.intro: Pelek was a deep gnome of Blingdenstone and a ghost in Gracklstugh in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|voosbur.title: Voosbur
OotA|voosbur.intro: Voosbur was a myconid adult in Gracklstugh in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|rumpadump.title: Rumpadump
OotA|rumpadump.intro: Rumpadump was a myconid sprout of Neverlight Grove in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|rumpadump.personality: Rumpadump was quite introverted, in contrast to its companion Stool's outgoing nature. Rumpadump would rather stay back from social encounters and would not release its rapport spores until it was vital.

OotA|lorthio bukbukken.title: Lorthio Bukbukken
OotA|lorthio bukbukken.intro: Lorthio Bukbukken was a duergar alchemist in Gracklstugh in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|mev flintknapper.title: Mev Flintknapper
OotA|mev flintknapper.intro: Mev Flintknapper was a deep gnome in Blingdenstone in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|glyphic shroomlight.title: Glyphic Shroomlight
OotA|glyphic shroomlight.intro: Glyphic Shroomlight was a young deep gnome acolyte of Segojan Earthcaller in Blingdenstone in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|glyphic shroomlight.personality: Glyphic was very nervous because he knew his position needed an older and more experienced priest.

OotA|udhask.title: Udhask
OotA|udhask.intro: Udhask was a deep gnome ghost in Blingdenstone in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|sark axebarrel.title: Sark Axebarrel
OotA|sark axebarrel.intro: Sark Axebarrel was a deep gnome guard in Blingdenstone in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|sladis vadir.title: Sladis Vadir
OotA|sladis vadir.intro: Sladis Vadir was a druid and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the late 15th century DR.
OotA|sladis vadir.personality: Sladis was always fascinated by the Underdark, but the madness spread by the demon lords destroyed his sanity. However, it was not too late for him to be cured.

OotA|krimgol muzgardt.title: Krimgol Muzgardt
OotA|krimgol muzgardt.intro: Krimgol Muzgardt was a duergar ale merchant of Clan Muzgardt from Gracklstugh in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|krimgol muzgardt.personality: The gem caused Krimgol to believe himself to be a calassabrak—a duergar without honor.

OotA|kinyel druu'giir.title: Kinyel Druu'giir
OotA|kinyel druu'giir.intro: Kinyel Druu'giir was a drow assassin of House Druu'giir in Menzoberranzan in Mantol-Derith in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|kinyel druu'giir.personality: Kinyel believed in her madness that killing the beholder would gain her the pardon of her house.

OotA|rystia zav.title: Rystia Zav
OotA|rystia zav.intro: Rystia Zav was a spy and a member of the Harpers from Nesme during the late 15th century DR.
OotA|rystia zav.personality: Rytsia had gone mad from loneliness, fear, and demon lords' influence. She believed that all beings she met were killers sent after her.

OotA|zilchyn q'leptin.title: Zilchyn Q'Leptin
OotA|zilchyn q'leptin.intro: Zilchyn Q'Leptin, or simply Zilch, was a drow wizard from Menzoberranzan in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|zilchyn q'leptin.personality: Zilchyn was a kleptomaniac. This behavior increased with the arrival of the demon lord.

OotA|ougalop.title: Ougalop
OotA|ougalop.intro: Ougalop was a kuo-toa in Mantol-Derith during the late 1480s or early 1490s DR.

OotA|amarith coppervein.title: Amarith Coppervein
OotA|amarith coppervein.intro: Amarith Coppervein was a dwarf in the Underdark in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|ryzliir symryvvin.title: Ryzliir Symryvvin
OotA|ryzliir symryvvin.intro: Ryzliir Symryvvin was a drow elite warrior in Menzoberranzan in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|velgor zolond.title: Velgor Zolond
OotA|velgor zolond.intro: Velgor Zolond was a drow mage in Menzoberranzan in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|servan llarabbar.title: Servan Llarabbar
OotA|servan llarabbar.intro: Servan Llarabbar was a drow mage in Velkynvelve in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|servan llarabbar.personality: Influenced by madness, Servan started to show heightened paranoia and megalomania. He dreamed of seceding Velkynvelve from Menzoberranzan, to found a land free from the control of the matron mothers.

OotA|jaal.title: Jaal
OotA|jaal.intro: Jaal was a stone giant living in Gracklstugh in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|veldyskar.title: Veldyskar
OotA|veldyskar.intro: Veldyskar was an intelligent basilisk living in Gravenhollow in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|veldyskar.personality: Veldyskar's philosophy during fights was to petrify first and ask questions later. To avoid problems, the keepers taught him how to cast a greater restoration spell.

OotA|shedrak.title: Shedrak
OotA|shedrak.intro: Shedrak of the Eyes was an adventurer who became the favored servant of a beholder living in the Wormwrithings in the Underdark in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|shedrak.personality: Karazikar had broken Shedrak's mind in order to make him its slave. Shedrak considered the beholder a god and would not tolerate any impudence or resistance to the beholder.

OotA|kurr.title: Kurr
OotA|kurr.intro: Kurr was a gnoll fang of Yeenoghu in the Labyrinth in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|kurr.personality: Kurr suffered from a peculiar form of demon lord–spread madness: he felt guilty for all the people he had killed. He hoped to find someone who could kill him and his pack.

OotA|gash.title: Gash
OotA|gash.intro: Gash was a gnoll in the Labyrinth in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|gash.personality: The abuses of the minotaurs had broken his will and Gash had become a pathetically loyal and willing slave of his masters.

OotA|slaughtertusk.title: Slaughtertusk
OotA|slaughtertusk.intro: Slaughtertusk was a nalfeshnee agent of Baphomet in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|slaughtertusk.personality: Slaughtertusk was a bully at heart, and pleaded for its life against enemies stronger than it. It was bored by the task assigned to it but knew not to disobey the Horned King.

OotA|krilelyn h'kar.title: Krilelyn H'Kar
OotA|krilelyn h'kar.intro: Krilelyn H'Kar was an elite warrior from House H'kar and a member of Bregan D'aerthe in Menzoberranzan in the late 15th century DR.
OotA|krilelyn h'kar.personality: Krilelyn was a sarcastic and devilishly charming male .

OotA|shinzi.title: Shinzi
OotA|shinzi.intro: Shinzi was a half-drow in Menzoberranzan during the late 1480s.

OotA|dalfred noakes.title: Dalfred Noakes
OotA|dalfred noakes.intro: Dalfred Noakes was a halfling innkeeper in Menzoberranzan in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|viln tirin.title: Viln Tirin
OotA|viln tirin.intro: Viln Tirin was a drow gang leader and cultist in Menzoberranzan in the late 15th century DR.

OotA|y'lara.title: Y'lara
OotA|y'lara.intro: "Y'lara" was a yochlol trapped in Menzoberranzan in the late 15th century DR.

CoS|strahd von zarovich.title: Strahd von Zarovich
CoS|strahd von zarovich.intro: Count Strahd von Zarovich was a vampire and the dark lord of the valley of Barovia, one of the Domains of Dread located in a remote corner of the Shadowfell.

CoS|ezmerelda d'avenir.title: Ezmerelda d'Avenir
CoS|ezmerelda d'avenir.intro: Ezmerelda d'Avenir, born under the surname Radanavich and preferring to be known by the nickname Ez, was a hunter of monsters (often vampires) who traveled across the Domains of Dread.
CoS|ezmerelda d'avenir.physical: Her right leg, just below the knee, was entirely prosthetic.

CoS|baba lysaga.title: Baba Lysaga
CoS|baba lysaga.intro: Baba Lysaga was an ancient and powerful hag who lived in Barovia.

CoS|zelraun roaringhorn.title: Zelraun Roaringhorn
CoS|zelraun roaringhorn.intro: Zelraun Roaringhorn was a wizard member of the Harpers in the late 15th century DR.
CoS|zelraun roaringhorn.physical: Despite being in his 50s in the late 1480s DR, Zelraun appeared to be only about 30 years old. He maintained his youthful look by means of potions of longevity.
CoS|zelraun roaringhorn.personality: Zelraun always maintained an attitude of self-assurance and pride that derived from his family. Accustomed to nobility and wealth, he used the money of his family on fine living. He loved to gamble.

CoS|eravien haund.title: Eravien Haund
CoS|eravien haund.intro: Eravien Haund was a half-elf and a noble member of the Lords' Alliance in the late 15th century DR.
CoS|eravien haund.personality: The half-elf was a charming and sly courtier, able to be immediately size up any social situation. However, he focused too much on socializing, distracting him from important information.

CoS|tatyana.title: Tatyana
CoS|tatyana.intro: Tatyana was a young Barovian woman. When count Strahd von Zarovich fell desperately in love with her, his unrequited obsession drove him to seal a pact with the Dark Powers, turning him into a vampire and plunging the entire valley into the Domains of Dread.
CoS|tatyana.physical: Tatyana was extraordinarily beautiful. She had auburn hair.

CoS|arik lorensk.title: Arik Lorensk
CoS|arik lorensk.intro: Arik Lorensk was a human barkeeper at the Blood of the Vine tavern in the village of Barovia.
CoS|arik lorensk.physical: Arik was a short man with a pudgy body. He spoke in a dull, hollow voice, and looked wary.
CoS|arik lorensk.personality: Arik was quite a quiet man, often ignoring attempts to question him.

SKT|augrek brighthelm.title: Augrek Brighthelm
SKT|augrek brighthelm.home: Bryn Shander, Ten Towns, Icewind Dale
SKT|augrek brighthelm.intro: Augrek Brighthelm was a deputy in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|augrek brighthelm.personality: Augrek had a good heart. She truly wanted to protect her city. She also loved Sheriff Markham Southwell.

SKT|duvessa shane.title: Duvessa Shane
SKT|duvessa shane.home: Bryn Shander, Ten Towns Icewind Dale
SKT|duvessa shane.intro: Duvessa Shane was the speaker of Bryn Shander in 1485 DR and sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|duvessa shane.personality: Duvessa inherited her mother's talent for negotiation and her father's charm. Some people thought her temerity but she always obtained what she wanted She believed that people of Ten Towns can survive all kinds of storms. Duvessa did not give an inch in any argument or conflict.

SKT|markham southwell.title: Markham Southwell
SKT|markham southwell.home: Bryn Shander, Ten Towns, Icewind Dale
SKT|markham southwell.intro: Markham Southwell was the sheriff of Bryn Shander in Icewind Dale in the late 15th century DR.
SKT|markham southwell.personality: Although likeable, Markham was taciturn and disinterested in small talk. He never showed his emotions while as he focused on his job of protecting Bryn Shander and Icewind Dale as a whole, as well as aiding Town Speaker Duvessa. He judged people by what they did, not what they said, and believed everyone should be treated with dignity.

SKT|beldora.title: Beldora
SKT|beldora.home: Bryn Shander, Ten Towns, Icewind Dale
SKT|beldora.intro: Beldora was a secret Harper agent in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|beldora.personality: Beldora liked to tell lies to people, believing that this made life more interesting. However, she wanted to protect poor people.

SKT|shalvus martholio.title: Shalvus Martholio
SKT|shalvus martholio.intro: Shalvus Martholio was was a Zhentarim spy inside Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|shalvus martholio.personality: Shalvus wanted rise the Zhent ranks quickly and hoped that Goldenfield was the right place to show his qualities. He accepted any risks to fed his ambition. However Shalvus truly loved animals.

SKT|lifferlas.title: Lifferlas
SKT|lifferlas.intro: Lifferlas was an awakened tree in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|lifferlas.personality: He loved children and was truly happy when they carved their names into his body or hung from his boughs.

SKT|zi liang.title: Zi Liang
SKT|zi liang.intro: Zi Liang was an acolyte of Chauntea at the Harvesthome Abbey in Goldenfields in the late 15th century DR.
SKT|zi liang.personality: Zi Liang was a true devotee of Chauntea. She believed that Goldenfields was a beacon of hope in the North and she must protect it. Zi didn't trust authority and went with her heart.

SKT|miros xelbrin.title: Miros Xelbrin
SKT|miros xelbrin.intro: Miros Xelbrin was an innkeeper in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|miros xelbrin.personality: Miros staunchly supported the Emerald Enclave's goals. For him it was okay if people joked about him, but not about his inn or his employers, in which case he descended into a rage.

SKT|naxene drathkala.title: Naxene Drathkala
SKT|naxene drathkala.intro: Naxene Drathkala was an member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|naxene drathkala.personality: Naxene believed that all can be resolved by magic and to be too smart to mistake something. She supported Laeral as a force of order in a chaotic world.

SKT|oren yogilvy.title: Oren Yogilvy
SKT|oren yogilvy.intro: Oren Yogilvy was a halfling musician in the Goldenfields in the late 15th century DR.
SKT|oren yogilvy.personality: Oren truly lived for and by his music. Sometimes he got into trouble but his music had always saved him from harm.

SKT|darathra shendrel.title: Darathra Shendrel
SKT|darathra shendrel.intro: Darathra Shendrel was a human knight and the Lord Protector of Triboar in the Dessarin Valley, as well as a former adventurer and a member of the Harpers, in the late 15th century DR.
SKT|darathra shendrel.personality: She was good-natured and had a reputation for fairness and sensible governance. Darathra believed that good people must be allowed to prosper free from tyranny and she was willing to give her life for the people of Triboar. She was resolute and never backed down, and pushed back when pressured.

SKT|darz helgar.title: Darz Helgar
SKT|darz helgar.intro: Darz Helgar was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|darz helgar.physical: Darz was a male human of Illuskan heritage.
SKT|darz helgar.personality: Darz had come to terms with his former life as a thief and had no regrets. He made a fresh start in Triboar and was finished with running away regardless of what happened.

SKT|urgala meltimer.title: Urgala Meltimer
SKT|urgala meltimer.intro: Urgala Meltimer was a former adventurer and the owner and innkeeper of Northshield House in Triboar in the Dessarin Valley in the late 15th century DR.
SKT|urgala meltimer.physical: Urgala was a female human of Turami descent, with dark brown skin and black hair. She kept herself fit and could be quite intimidating.
SKT|urgala meltimer.personality: She liked retirement and was very protective of her home, and was willing to fight to preserve it and the homes of her neighbors. She believed violence was a necessity for survival in a violent world but admonished all guests in the inn bearing weapons to keep them sheathed. She tolerated neither bullies nor monsters, curbing their behavior with a sharp word and a firm hand, or driving them out with violence if necessary.

SKT|othovir.title: Othovir
SKT|othovir.intro: Othovir was a shopkeeper in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|othovir.physical: Othovir was a handsome and charismatic male human of Illuskan stock.
SKT|othovir.personality: Othovir cared greatly about his good name. He became angry if he found out someone was looking into his private life or his past.

SKT|ghelryn foehammer.title: Ghelryn Foehammer
SKT|ghelryn foehammer.intro: Ghelryn "Goldhand" Foehammer was a shield dwarf master smith of the town of Triboar in the Dessarin Valley in the mid-to-late 14 and late 15 centuries DR.
SKT|ghelryn foehammer.personality: Ghelryn was goodhearted but he zealously hated orcs and giants and he would never run from a fight, especially against them. He believed dwarves must forge their legacy and that he should stand up for Clan Foehammer and for dwarves everywhere.

SKT|slarkrethel.title: Slarkrethel
SKT|slarkrethel.intro: Slarkrethel was a huge kraken wizard and Chosen of Umberlee, who also founded the Kraken Society.
SKT|slarkrethel.physical: Like his origins, Slarkrethel's appearance was disputed. The majority of sages described him as a giant squid, indeed, the giant squid was the symbol of the Kraken Society, however, later images of krakens were described as far less squid-like, with fins as well as tentacles, and recognizable faces. On one aspect, all could agree however, Slarkrethel was a leviathan of a creature, gargantuan in size.

SKT|narth tezrin.title: Narth Tezrin
SKT|narth tezrin.intro: Narth Tezrin was an resident of Triboar and member of the Lionshield Coster during the late 15th century DR.
SKT|narth tezrin.personality: Narth had an adventurous spirit. He sought to become a person of renown, no matter the risks. He adored his colleague Alaestra and this stopped him from running away in search of adventures.

SKT|serissa.title: Serissa
SKT|serissa.intro: Serissa was the storm giant heiress sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|serissa.personality: Serissa above all feared a civil war among the different giant races, which had the potential restart the war against the dragons. She knew well the envy of her older sisters but considered them harmless. Serissa trusted only Iymrith and her uncle Uthor.

SKT|iymrith.title: Iymrith
SKT|iymrith.intro: Iymrith, also known as the Doom of the Desert and the Dragon of the Statues, was a powerful blue dragon sorcerer that dwelled within an abandoned amphitheater in the ruined Netherese city of Anarath in the Anauroch desert.
SKT|iymrith.personality: Iymrith was manipulative and cunning, as shown by her ongoing deception of Serissa, daughter of the storm giant King Hekaton, for an extended duration of time. Her ultimate goal was to shed her physical form and achieve godhood. Like many dragons, she was shown to be prideful and arrogant, unwilling to flee in battle or abandon her treasure to those that may lessen her wealth.

SKT|felgolos.title: Felgolos
SKT|felgolos.intro: Felgolos was a very imprudent bronze dragon, that traveled across Faerûn causing trouble and surviving perils, much to the befuddlement of many dragonologists. Regardless, he sought joy and fun in all of his undertakings.
SKT|felgolos.physical: Felgolos' scales had a particularly glossy sheen.
SKT|felgolos.personality: Felgolos was always amiable and curious to a fault. He enjoyed wandering across the Realms, especially into the territories of other dragons, regardless of the inherent danger. He was very knowledgeable about matters of everyday life in Faerûn.

SKT|tholtz daggerdark.title: Tholtz Daggerdark
SKT|tholtz daggerdark.intro: Tholtz Daggerdark was a sea-captain in Trackless Sea sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|harshnag.title: Harshnag
SKT|harshnag.physical: Harshnag was particularly burly-looking, even for a frost giant. He had skin as white as snow, light blue eyes and pale blue hair which he often kept tied back in a braid.

SKT|morak ur'gray.title: Morak Ur'gray
SKT|morak ur'gray.intro: Morak Ur'gray was an innkeeper in Nightstone in the late 15th century DR.
SKT|morak ur'gray.personality: Morak was a natural leader and always optimistic. He thought for sure that Lady Velrosa Nandar would send help for them.

SKT|darthag ulgar.title: Darthag Ulgar
SKT|darthag ulgar.intro: Darthag Ulgar was a merchant of the Lionshield Coster and the operator of their trading post in Nightstone during the late 15th century DR.

SKT|zephyros.title: Zephyros
SKT|zephyros.intro: Zephyros was an eccentric cloud giant wizard sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|zephyros.personality: Zephyros was very open-minded to "small folks".

SKT|amarath.title: Amarath
SKT|amarath.intro: Amarath was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|dellvon ludwig.title: Dellvon Ludwig
SKT|dellvon ludwig.intro: Delvon Ludwig was a priest of Torm who lived in the Sword Coast North during the late 15th century DR.

SKT|artus cimber.title: Artus Cimber
SKT|artus cimber.physical: As a young child, Artus was scrawny with dark brown eyes. Through his long adventuring career, Artus earned many scars of various shapes and sizes that covered his back and stomach, including the scars left by the Zhent torturers. When Artus settled in Chult, he was gifted a lightweight lush green hooded tunic, perfect for the hot and humid climate of the jungle.
SKT|artus cimber.personality: Unlike his brother Oric, Artus was intelligent and observant. Artus was passionate about the preservation of knowledge and history, especially if it pertained to Chult, where he'd spent most of his life with Alisanda. Since the disappearance of Mezro and his wife, Artus longed to be reunited with her again.

SKT|sorelisa zandra.title: Sorelisa Zandra
SKT|sorelisa zandra.intro: Sorelisa Zandra, was a Zhentarim bounty hunter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|hantanus tarm.title: Hantanus Tarm
SKT|hantanus tarm.intro: Hantanus Tarm was the castellan of Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|darlow.title: Darlow
SKT|darlow.intro: Darlow was the name of a black bear that lived within the Harvesthome Abbey of Goldenfields during the late 15th century DR.

SKT|aerglas.title: Aerglas
SKT|aerglas.intro: Aerglas was a druid of the Emerald Enclave who lived in Goldenfields during the mid–15th century DR.

SKT|turlang.title: Turlang
SKT|turlang.intro: Turlang was a treant who guarded the northwestern region of the High Forest, a grove known as Turlang's Wood. He "governed" over an area of a hundred or so trees, a gentle, calm but authoritative presence over his arboreal realm.

SKT|tharra shyndle.title: Tharra Shyndle
SKT|tharra shyndle.intro: Tharra Shyndle was a druid member of the Emerald Enclave in the High Forest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|quinn nardrosz.title: Quinn Nardrosz
SKT|quinn nardrosz.intro: Quinn Nardrosz was a retired ranger in Jalanthar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|chazlauth yarghorn.title: Chazlauth Yarghorn
SKT|chazlauth yarghorn.intro: Chazlauth Yarghorn was a wizard in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|irizzorl.title: Irizzorl
SKT|irizzorl.intro: Irizzorl was a silver dragon wyrmling, living in the tower of the wizard Chazlauth Yarghorn's Waterdeep residence, sometime after the War of the Silver Marches in the late 15th century DR.

SKT|kaelen sarssir.title: Kaelen Sarssir
SKT|kaelen sarssir.intro: Kaelen Sarssir was an actor and the proprietor of the Talking Troll tavern in Triboar in the Savage Frontier in the late 15th century DR.

SKT|hyuth kolstaag.title: Hyuth Kolstaag
SKT|hyuth kolstaag.intro: Hyuth Kolstaag was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|zindra winterbow.title: Zindra Winterbow
SKT|zindra winterbow.intro: Zindra Winterbow was a guide in Dessarin Valley sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|okssort.title: Okssort
SKT|okssort.intro: Okssort was a fire giant who, together with his wife Ildmane, led an attack on Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|harthos zymorven.title: Harthos Zymorven
SKT|harthos zymorven.intro: Harthos Zymorven was the commander of Zymorven Hall in the Rauvin Vale during the late 15th century DR.

SKT|tholzar brenner.title: Tholzar Brenner
SKT|tholzar brenner.intro: Tholzar Brenner was a corrupt watch officer in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|kriga moonmusk.title: Kriga Moonmusk
SKT|kriga moonmusk.intro: Kriga Moonmusk was the great chief of the Blue Bear Tribe during the late 15th century DR.
SKT|kriga moonmusk.personality: Despite her advanced age, Kriga was exceptionally shrewd. When traveling throughout the North, Great Chief Kriga was transported in a fur-covered litter that was carried by four Blue Bear tribesmen.

SKT|pencheska.title: Pencheska
SKT|pencheska.intro: Pencheska was a succubus in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR.
SKT|pencheska.personality: Pencheska was unhappy with her situation as a slave of Tarul. She did not immediately attack the lich's enemies.

SKT|nelkin danniker.title: Nelkin Danniker
SKT|nelkin danniker.intro: Nelkin Danniker, better known as the Snail, was a member of the Zhentarim in Daggerford sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|zirazylym.title: Zirazylym
SKT|zirazylym.intro: Zirazylym was an adult bronze dragon in Daggerford sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|krowen valharrow.title: Krowen Valharrow
SKT|krowen valharrow.intro: Krowen Valharrow was an archmage member of the Harpers in Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|dral thelev.title: Dral Thelev
SKT|dral thelev.intro: Dral Thelev was an one-eyed half-orc innkeeper in Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|pheszeltan.title: Pheszeltan
SKT|pheszeltan.intro: Pheszeltan was a great Hierophant Druid of Mielikki and later Silvanus who lived somewhere in the deep-most reaches of the Forgotten Forest in the North in the mid–14th century DR. He was immortal and still living there by 1485 DR.

SKT|draac xorlarrin.title: Draac Xorlarrin
SKT|draac xorlarrin.intro: Draac Xorlarrin was a member of House Xorlarrin and an ally of the fire giant Duke Zalto sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|draac xorlarrin.personality: Draac was a slippery individual. He did not want to die under any circumstance.

SKT|silixia.title: Silixia
SKT|silixia.intro: Silixia was a young brass dragon in the Gray Vale sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|wormblod.title: Wormblod
SKT|wormblod.intro: Wormblod was the chieftain of the Great Worm Tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|noori.title: Noori
SKT|noori.intro: Noori was a member of the Great Worm Tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|lonely moor.title: Lonely Moor
SKT|lonely moor.intro: The Lonely Moor was an area of boggy land northwest of Evereska in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn. It was occupied by bands of gnolls and bugbears.

SKT|fylo nelgorn.title: Fylo Nelgorn
SKT|fylo nelgorn.intro: Fylo Nelgorn was a Zhent diplomat in Nesmé sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|avgar filroy.title: Avgar Filroy
SKT|avgar filroy.intro: Avgar Filroy was the only innkeeper in Noanar's Hold until sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|tau.title: Tau
SKT|tau.intro: Tau was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|sharda.title: Sharda
SKT|sharda.intro: Sharda was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|zorkh.title: Zorkh
SKT|zorkh.intro: Zorkh was a stone giant hermit sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|zorkh.physical: Zorkh was mute; he could understand the Giant language but could not speak.

SKT|nirva.title: Nirva
SKT|nirva.intro: Nirva was a cloud giant on a quest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|albie grizlow.title: Albie Grizlow
SKT|albie grizlow.intro: Albie Grizlow was a teenager cattle rancher in Uluvin, who lived there around the time of the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|kolbaz.title: Kolbaz
SKT|kolbaz.intro: Kolbaz was an old and cantankerous mage and a member of the Harpers in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|khaspere drylund.title: Khaspere Drylund
SKT|khaspere drylund.intro: Khaspere Drylund was a noble in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|khaspere drylund.personality: Khaspere was a little man. If someone cornered and threatened him, he revealed everything about his criminal business.

SKT|moog.title: Moog
SKT|moog.intro: Moog was a lonely hill giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|gharwin umbryl.title: Gharwin Umbryl
SKT|gharwin umbryl.intro: Gharwin Umbryl was the proprietor of the Smiling Satyr tavern outside Loudwater in the Delimbiyr Vale in the late 15th century DR.

SKT|sandyse thunderquill.title: Sandyse Thunderquill
SKT|sandyse thunderquill.intro: Sandyse Thunderquill was a confident but socially awkward mage and a member of the Harpers in Neverwinter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|thestryl mellardin.title: Thestryl Mellardin
SKT|thestryl mellardin.intro: Thestryl Mellardin was a pale girl mage and a member of the Harpers in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|eigeron.title: Eigeron
SKT|eigeron.intro: Eigeron was a ghost cloud giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|oinker-boinker.title: Oinker-Boinker
SKT|oinker-boinker.intro: Oinker-Boinker was an ettin sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|draunn.title: Draunn
SKT|draunn.intro: Draunn was a primordial trapped beneath the Greypeak Mountains. A portion of Draunn called the Steinfang was located in Deadstone Cleft.

SKT|elister noggins.title: Elister Noggins
SKT|elister noggins.intro: Elister Noggins was a rock gnome priest of Gond from Loudwater.

SKT|cinderhild.title: Cinderhild
SKT|cinderhild.intro: Cinderhild was a fire giant and the belligerent daughter of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|cinderhild.personality: Her father told Cinderhild that Toril was full of wonders but gave her no permission to leave and thus she was angry with Zalto. She had a low opinion of her brother.

SKT|zaltember.title: Zaltember
SKT|zaltember.intro: Zaltember was a fire giant and the sadistic son of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|zaltember.personality: Zaltember was at heart a bully and a coward. If injured, he quickly escaped to his mother. He also tried to impress enemies by declaring himself to be the son of Zalto.

SKT|kartha-kaya.title: Kartha-Kaya
