SKT|kartha-kaya.intro: Kartha-Kaya was the chief of a yak folk village near Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|jasper dimmerchasm.title: Jasper Dimmerchasm
SKT|jasper dimmerchasm.intro: Jasper Dimmerchasm was a shield dwarf member of the Zhentarim and prisoner of the fire giants in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|cressaro.title: Cressaro
SKT|cressaro.intro: Cressaro was the cloud giant castellan of Lyn Armaal sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|cressaro.personality: Cressaro followed the orders of Sansuri without doubts, deeply loyal to her.

SKT|kaaltar.title: Kaaltar
SKT|kaaltar.intro: Kaaltar was a cloud giant who resided in Lyn Armaal during the late 15th century DR.
SKT|kaaltar.physical: Kaaltar was tall and weighed , equivalent in size to a muscular human male.

SKT|vaal.title: Vaal
SKT|vaal.intro: Vaal was a cloud giant count sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|tartha.title: Tartha
SKT|tartha.intro: Tartha was a fire giant duchess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|hellenhild.title: Hellenhild
SKT|hellenhild.intro: Hellenhild was a frost giant jarl sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|hellenhild.personality: Hellenhild respected battle prowess above all.

SKT|braxow.title: Braxow
SKT|braxow.intro: Braxow was a stone giant thane sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|braxow.personality: Braxow feared not following the giant pantheon's ways.

SKT|zaldar floshin.title: Zaldar Floshin
SKT|zaldar floshin.intro: Zaldar Floshin was a half-elven member of the noble elven House Floshin, and a sea-captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|zaldar floshin.personality: Zaldar was said to be a rather brooding individual.

SKT|klarz.title: Klarz
SKT|klarz.intro: Klarz was a hobgoblin sea-captain on the Trackless Sea in the late 15th century DR. He was the captain of the Koalinth.

SKT|nimir.title: Nimir
SKT|nimir.intro: Nimir was a storm giant residing in the Maelstrom in the Trackless Sea during the late 15th century DR.
SKT|nimir.personality: Nimir was a rather insightful giant who believed that his race should establish an alliance with the smaller races, rather than continuously warring with them. To this end he felt that the princess Serissa was a perfect successor to the throne of King Hekaton and was willing to sacrifice his life in order to protect her.

TftYP-AtG|durnan.title: Durnan
TftYP-AtG|durnan.intro: Durnan (), occasionally known as Durham, was the gruff, burly yet close-mouthed Masked Lord of Waterdeep who ran the Yawning Portal Inn and considered himself the self-appointed gatekeeper to Undermountain. He was known for having explored Undermountain.
TftYP-AtG|durnan.personality: He had a strong dislike for hobgoblins. Mirt believed he may have lost family, friends, and neighbors—and even been left homeless—by hobgoblin raids, although Durnan himself would never speak on the subject.

TftYP-DiT|tarul var.title: Tarul Var
TftYP-DiT|tarul var.intro: Tarul Var was a lich necromancer and Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford in 1486 DR.
TftYP-DiT|tarul var.personality: Tarul was an arrogant and devious individual. He knew that his success depended on a favorable result from the Bloodgate mission, but he did not truly believe that he could fail. He believed that all living creatures were weaker than liches.

TftYP-DiT|white maw.title: White Maw
TftYP-DiT|white maw.intro: White Maw was a massive intelligent gray ooze in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR.
TftYP-DiT|white maw.personality: White Maw absorbed the identities of the creatures it ingested. This granted it sentience, but with a price; the conflicting personalities of those it consumed drove it to madness.

TftYP-DiT|ooze master.title: Ooze Master
TftYP-DiT|ooze master.intro: The Ooze Master was a monstrous intelligent ooze in the Doomvault dungeon.

TftYP-DiT|durnan.title: Durnan

TftYP-DiT|mennek ariz.title: Mennek Ariz
TftYP-DiT|mennek ariz.intro: Mennek Ariz was a traitorous Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford.
TftYP-DiT|mennek ariz.personality: Mennek, as an enchanter, greatly despised the preeminence of the necromancers over his land and secretly aligned with rebels who sought to overthrow Szass Tam and the necromancers from control of Thay.

TftYP-TSC|ashardalon.title: Ashardalon
TftYP-TSC|ashardalon.intro: Ashardalon was a powerful red dragon who was mentioned in songs throughout the multiverse. He was known for his depredations and unorthodox methods to extend his own life. Although he later achieved the status of greatwyrm, he remained relentless in his pursuit of godhood.
TftYP-TSC|ashardalon.physical: An extremely old red dragon, Ashardalon had an appearance that diverged somewhat from usual ancient dragons of his kind. He possessed unusual demonic features and a scar on his chest in the shape of an enormous winged humanoid.
TftYP-TSC|ashardalon.personality: Ashardalon was regarded as a self-important dragon with an almost desperate attachment to his own life. He was willing to go through whatever means necessary to prevent his own death.

TftYP-TSC|belak.title: Belak
TftYP-TSC|belak.intro: Belak the Outcast was a dark druid allegedly exiled from his druidic circle for reasons unknown. He took up residence in the Sunless Citadel in order to study the Gulthias Tree.
TftYP-TSC|belak.personality: He was an eccentric druid, known for his dangerous alignment with the unnatural. Driven by radical views on expanding nature's reach, he was characterized by great hubris, cold pragmatism, and cruel possessiveness.

TftYP-ToH|durnan.title: Durnan
TftYP-ToH|durnan.intro: Durnan (), occasionally known as Durham, was the gruff, burly yet close-mouthed Masked Lord of Waterdeep who ran the Yawning Portal Inn and considered himself the self-appointed gatekeeper to Undermountain. He was known for having explored Undermountain.

ToA|xandala.title: Xandala
ToA|xandala.intro: Xandala () was a half-elf who sought out the Ring of Winter in Chult during the late 15th century DR.
ToA|xandala.physical: Areas of Xandala's skin were covered by a thin layer of scales. These scales were a result of her draconic heritage.
ToA|xandala.personality: Xandala craved the power of the Ring of Winter as she thought it would bring her immense power and immortality. She believed that she was destined for greatness because of her draconic ancestry.

ToA|zindar.title: Zindar
ToA|zindar.intro: Zindar () was a half-dragon sorcerer and harbormaster of Port Nyanzaru in the late 15th century DR. He was also a central member of the Ytepka Society.
ToA|zindar.personality: He had an imposing presence that he liked to use to more efficiently diffuse disputes during the course of his job. He took pride in his work and his city, and had little patience for any who would bring harm to either. He kept his business honest, although he was not above retaliating against those who crossed him.

ToA|liara portyr.title: Liara Portyr
ToA|liara portyr.intro: Liara Portyr () was a member of the Portyr patriar family, the commander of Fort Beluarian and the highest-ranking member of the Flaming Fist in Chult in the late 15th century DR. She answered only to Duke Ulder Ravengard of Baldur's Gate.
ToA|liara portyr.personality: Liara was a hard-hearted and dedicated leader who held high respect for militaristic order. She saw hardships as challenges for her to overcome. She admired those who took up the adventuring life.

ToA|ras nsi.title: Ras Nsi
ToA|ras nsi.intro: Ras (or "Duke") Nsi () was one of the seven barae, the Chosen of Ubtao. He was infamous for seeking bloody and violent revenge against the Eshowe tribe of Chult and for the creation of the majority of the undead that roam that land.
ToA|ras nsi.physical: Ras Nsi dressed the part of a Cormyrean noble, wearing a sky-blue cloak and bearing a rapier. He had soft features, but his eyes supernaturally glowed bright red whenever he became irritable or spoke of his zeal for the city of Mezro. After the Spellplague, he resembled a yuan-ti malison, with his torso and face wrapped in bandages, and bore a flaming longsword.
ToA|ras nsi.personality: The first impression one might receive when meeting Ras Nsi was that he was decadent and weak-willed. Nsi, despite his exile, maintained a powerful devotion to both Ubtao and his holy city. He strongly opposed King Osaw's opening of the once hidden city to non-Tabaxi.

ToA|acererak.title: Acererak
ToA|acererak.personality: Acererak traveled through the multiverse in search of artifacts, which he liked to lock away in trap-ridden dungeons to watch adventurers suffer and die. He then enjoyed trapping their souls in his phylactery, whose location was unknown. Although having had the power and opportunities to ascend to godhood, Acererak had no interest in being worshiped, despite having his share of followers whose suffering he enjoyed watching.

ToA|artus cimber.title: Artus Cimber
ToA|artus cimber.physical: As a young child, Artus was scrawny with dark brown eyes. Through his long adventuring career, Artus earned many scars of various shapes and sizes that covered his back and stomach, including the scars left by the Zhent torturers. When Artus settled in Chult, he was gifted a lightweight lush green hooded tunic, perfect for the hot and humid climate of the jungle.
ToA|artus cimber.personality: Unlike his brother Oric, Artus was intelligent and observant. Artus was passionate about the preservation of knowledge and history, especially if it pertained to Chult, where he'd spent most of his life with Alisanda. Since the disappearance of Mezro and his wife, Artus longed to be reunited with her again.

ToA|dragonbait.title: Dragonbait
ToA|dragonbait.intro: Dragonbait, also referred to as Champion, was the finhead saurial paladin companion and the soul-brother of the adventurer Alias, who was transported to Toril, alongside a small community of his people, by the Rotting God Moander.
ToA|dragonbait.physical: Dragonbait stood at in height, not counting his single head fin, the telltale sign of him being a finhead saurial. His low height was due to his posture, canted towards his hips, and balanced by a long thick tail. His mouth was short, thinner, and more rounded than that of lizardfolk.
ToA|dragonbait.personality: Dragonbait was adaptable and quite intuitive. Like many other paladins, he was good, caring, kind, and righteous, a being of a pure soul. That was the reason why he was chosen as a sacrifice to bring Alias to life by Cassana, and Phalse.

ToA|syndra silvane.title: Syndra Silvane
ToA|syndra silvane.intro: Syndra Silvane () was a merchant and former adventurer living in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 DR.
ToA|syndra silvane.physical: After becoming affected by the death curse, Syndra began wearing a hood and silver mask to hide her features.

ToA|wakanga o'tamu.title: Wakanga O'tamu
ToA|wakanga o'tamu.intro: Wakanga O'tamu () was a merchant prince in Port Nyanzaru during the late 15th century DR. He was an information broker of sorts, offering lost lore and arcane knowledge as well as dealing in magical items.
ToA|wakanga o'tamu.physical: Wakanga was a wealthy Chultan merchant and the only arcane spellcaster among Port Nyanzaru's merchant princes. He was often described as a wizard who had a masterful command of his Art. He was capable of quickly learning ancient and powerful Chultan spells.
ToA|wakanga o'tamu.personality: He enjoyed life's luxuries, especially pleasures of the flesh. He was a dandy who was easily seduced by smart women, though this was possibly only a carefully constructed public image. Those who called on him at his villa might find him absorbed in gilded tomes and disinterested in speaking until he had finished his reading.

ToA|drufi.title: Drufi
ToA|drufi.intro: Drufi () was a frost giant who led an attack on Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

ToA|taban.title: Taban
ToA|taban.intro: Taban was a gladiator active in Port Nyanzaru in Chult during the late 15th century DR.
ToA|taban.personality: He was stubborn but proud. If defeated in a fight, he became ashamed and eager to prove himself. He was also a gambler who placed bets at Port Nyanzaru's Executioner's Run.

ToA|river mist.title: River Mist
ToA|river mist.intro: River Mist was a tabaxi guide that worked out of Port Nyanzaru in the late 15th century DR. She worked alongside her brother, Flask of Wine both as guides and assets of the Zhentarim.
ToA|river mist.personality: River was more comfortable in the jungles of Chult and could not abide the crowded streets of Port Nyanzaru.

ToA|shago.title: Shago
ToA|shago.intro: Shago () was a Chultan man working as a guide out of Fort Beluarian, Chult in the late 15th century DR.
ToA|shago.physical: He was quite large, standing at and . He had rippling muscles and a winning smile.
ToA|shago.personality: Shago was boastful, describing himself as having "the heart of a tyrannosaurus" and to be unafraid of hard work or danger. He claimed to be proficient in fighting, foraging, canoeing, camping, and whatever else a client might need from a guide.

ToA|aremag.title: Aremag
ToA|aremag.intro: Aremag () was a dragon turtle who lived in the Bay of Chult from at least the mid–14 to the late 15 centuries DR. His activities in the bay were well known by the locals of Port Nyanzaru.
ToA|aremag.physical: Thanks to the fight with the Narwhal, Aremag had a blind, milky left eye and was missing a piece of its shell. He had a particularly grouchy personality.
ToA|aremag.personality: Aremag thought highly of himself, and expected deference from any sailors he encountered. When forced into combat with his patrons, he would often avoid direct combat, and rather knock his enemies into the water or capsize their vessels for them to be devoured by reef sharks.

ToA|soshen.title: Soshen
ToA|soshen.intro: Soshen was a member of the city guard of Port Nyanzaru during the late 15th century DR.

ToA|ymezra.title: Ymezra
ToA|ymezra.intro: Ymezra was the daughter of Jessamine, one of the merchant princes of Port Nyanzaru in Chult during the late 15th century DR.

ToA|niles breakbone.title: Niles Breakbone
ToA|niles breakbone.intro: Niles Breakbone was a knight in the Order of the Gauntlet as well as the commander of Camp Vengeance in Chult during the late 15th century DR.
ToA|niles breakbone.personality: Niles was a devout servant of Tyr who was well-versed in traditional battles of two armies facing off against one another, however he was exasperated by guerrilla tactics that were so-often used in the jungle setting. He was a dedicated member of the Order of the Gauntlet and was seen as representing its best qualities, although the stain of the jungle campaign had led him to become desperate and unreasonable. He viewed Camp Vengeance as existing in a permanent state of emergency, and anyone who refused his orders—regardless of their relationship to the Order of the Gauntlet—was deemed a traitor to be punished or executed.

ToA|nanny pu'pu.title: Nanny Pu'pu
ToA|nanny pu'pu.intro: Nanny Pu'pu () was a green hag and the lone inhabitant of Mbala in Chult as of the late 15th century DR.
ToA|nanny pu'pu.physical: She appeared as an arthritic old crone, with skeletal features and sallow skin. She wore yellow clay streaked over her dark skinned face in an apparent design of a skull. She walked with such a pronounced hunch that she appeared almost bestial.
ToA|nanny pu'pu.personality: Nanny Pu'pu played the role of an old wise woman perfectly even as she conspired to kill and eat any travelers she met. Her preferred method was to isolate individuals from their friends and pick them off one-by-one in order to avoid direct conflict. She used trickery and illusions to lure potential victims to Mbala.

ToA|zongo.title: Zongo
ToA|zongo.intro: Zongo was a triceratops owned by Faroul and Gondolo, a pair of hapless jungle guides operating out of Port Nyanzaru, Chult during the late 15th century DR.
ToA|zongo.physical: Zongo was slow-moving and notably flatulent.

ToA|kupalué.title: Kupalué
ToA|kupalué.intro: Kupalué (), also known as Kupa or "Weed", was the vegepygmy companion of the Chultan druid Qawasha in the late 15th century DR. Kupalué's name meant "walking weed" in the Chultan language.
ToA|kupalué.physical: The vegepygmy stood tall and weighed about . If he became wet, the waterlogged vegepygmy gained an additional
ToA|kupalué.personality: Kupalué was quite knowledgeable about the many types of animal and plant life that were native to Chult. Left to his own devices, he moved slowly and observantly through the jungle, using the tendrils on his body to feel and taste the air around him, thus allowing him to connect to the jungle more deeply than any human. He had a sarcastic sense of humor and a fascination with magic.

ToA|tzindelor.title: Tzindelor
ToA|tzindelor.intro: Tzindelor, also known as Tinder, was a young red dragon who laired within Wyrmheart Mine in Chult throughout the latter half of the 15th century DR. She was further known by such honorifics as "your titanic, blazing majesty" and "thou unquenchable, unendurable furnace" by her kobold minions.
ToA|tzindelor.personality: Owing to her youth, there was much that Tzindelor did not know or understand about the world. Regardless of this naivete, she was confident, cruel, and expected to be treated with unwavering deference and overblown flattery. She delighted in seeing and hearing her prey screaming and dying in the flames of her breath weapon.

ToA|qawasha.title: Qawasha
ToA|qawasha.intro: Qawasha () was a druid of the Emerald Enclave that sought to eradicate the undead that infested the jungles of Chult during the late 15th century DR. To this end, he worked as a guide alongside his vegepygmy companion, Kupalué.
ToA|qawasha.physical: Qawasha was a Chultan man who stood tall and weighed . He was physically fit, capable of outrunning a ghoul.
ToA|qawasha.personality: He was a hard worker and had a calming demeanor, able to assuage people's fears and inspire their confidence, especially in the face of the dangers of the Chultan jungle. He was unafraid to travel into the dangerous depths of the jungle, and would sometimes seek the solitude of nature in such places. His many days spent wandering and meditating in the jungle had led him to certain understandings about the world, such as that death and decay were simply the other side of the same coin as life and growth, that silence was the key to communing with the jungle, and that evil had lodged itself like a painful thorn into the minds of mortals.

ToA|asharra.title: Asharra
ToA|asharra.intro: Asharra (), or Teacher, as she was known by her own kind, was an elderly aarakocra druid, as well the leader of Kir Sabal near the end of the 15th century DR. She was venerated by the others in her community, to the point of being considered a saint.
ToA|asharra.personality: Asharra was exceptionally insightful and equally ambitious. While she had a propensity for manipulating others, she never acted in a manner that was malicious or uncaring. She knew the specifications of a ritual called the Dance of the Seven Winds, that allowed a small number of people to temporarily gain the power of flight.

ToA|bag of nails.title: Bag of Nails
ToA|bag of nails.intro: Bag of Nails was a tabaxi that lived in Chult during the late 15th century DR. As of the year of the death curse, he dwelled within an abandoned building in the lost city of Omu.
ToA|bag of nails.personality: In his older years, Bag of Nails wished to receive a death worthy of a hunter. In truth he had lost his mind to senility and began seeing every individual he met as his quarry.

ToA|gorra.title: Gorra
ToA|gorra.home: Tomb of the Nine Gods, Omu
ToA|gorra.intro: Gorra, who was also known as Withers, was an undead wight that acted as an overseer in the Tomb of the Nine Gods.

ToA|cryonax.title: Cryonax
ToA|cryonax.intro: Cryonax () was the Prince of evil cold-using creatures, and one of the inhabitants of the Para-Elemental Plane of Ice.
ToA|cryonax.physical: He somewhat resembled a yeti with two tentacles in place of each arm. He stood tall and weighed . He radiated an aura of terrible cold, said to chill both the body and soul of those around him.

LMoP|mormesk the wraith.title: Mormesk
LMoP|mormesk the wraith.home: Wave Echo Cave, the Sword Mountains
LMoP|mormesk the wraith.intro: Mormesk was a human mage and the last defending wizard against Uruth Ukrypt's raid on the Wave Echo Cave. He was turned into a wraith that haunted the cavern for over half a millennium.
LMoP|mormesk the wraith.physical: The human wizard was said to be a powerful spellcaster. He coveted treasure and wealth, both in life and in undeath. As well as general wealth, Mormesk desired magical equipment, such as spellbooks, but also longed for arcane knowledge.

LMoP|sister garaele.title: Garaele
LMoP|sister garaele.intro: Sister Garaele was an elf cleric who lived in Phandalin in the late 15th century DR. She was a worshiper of Tymora, and spent much time caring for the Shrine of Luck in town.
LMoP|sister garaele.personality: Although scholarly, the young acolyte of Tymora had a strong desire to travel and do good for the people of Phandalin. She was also said to be quite zealous, and was known to exuberantly preach anywhere and everywhere, including in peoples' homes. She was said to scold the townsfolk whenever bad fortune befell the town, suggesting that it was because they had not showed sufficient devotion to Tymora.

HotDQ|captain othelstan.title: Othelstan
HotDQ|captain othelstan.intro: Captain Othelstan was a member of the Cult of the Dragon who supervised the Cult-controlled village of Parnast in the Greypeak Mountains.
HotDQ|captain othelstan.physical: The captain was a strong man with black skin.

HotDQ|glazhael the cloudchaser.title: Glazhael
HotDQ|glazhael the cloudchaser.intro: Glazhael the Cloudchaser was a white dragon allied with the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin.
HotDQ|glazhael the cloudchaser.physical: While Glazhael was described by some as being particularly handsome for a white dragon, he was not especially intelligent.
HotDQ|glazhael the cloudchaser.personality: He believed that dragons were superior to all other beings and was proud to take actions in service to the exalted queen Tiamat.

RoT|lord volmer.title: Volmer
RoT|lord volmer.intro: Lord Volmer was a bone devil from the Nine Hells that ventured to Toril on the Prime Material plane during the late 15th century DR.

RoT|taraz the fair.title: Taraz
RoT|taraz the fair.intro: Taraz the Fair was an efreeti trapped in Xonthal's Tower by the wizard Xonthal circa 1380 DR.

PotA|yngukulub the devourer.title: Yngukulub
PotA|yngukulub the devourer.intro: Yngukulub the Devourer was an aboleth ally of Gar Shatterkeel at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar-Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis.
PotA|yngukulub the devourer.personality: Yngukulub obeyed Gar because it believed that in the new era of Olhydra the aboleth would rule the world.

OotA|deepking horgar steelshadow v.title: Horgar Steelshadow V
OotA|deepking horgar steelshadow v.intro: Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V was the duergar king of Gracklstugh during the late 15th century DR.

SKT|sir baric nylef.title: Baric Nylef
SKT|sir baric nylef.intro: Baric Nylef was a knight of Tyr that lived in Bryn Shander some time after the War of the Silver Marches.
SKT|sir baric nylef.personality: Baric was a true devotee of Tyr. He waited for the day when he would meet his god. In the meantime, he felt that he must clean the world from evil.

SKT|chief guh.title: Guh
SKT|chief guh.personality: Like her fellow hill giants, Guh was not very intelligent, and her plot was a questionable one. She believed that if she became the world's biggest giant, none would question her. In addition, Guh was a glutton.

SKT|countess sansuri.title: Sansuri
SKT|countess sansuri.intro: Countess Sansuri was the ruler of the cloud giants sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

SKT|duke zalto.title: Zalto
SKT|duke zalto.intro: Duke Zalto was the ruler of the fire giants sometime after the War of the Silver Marches circa the late 15th century DR.
SKT|duke zalto.personality: Zalto was a warmonger, dreaming to lead his kind at war in the glory of Surtr and Annam. He would sacrifice his family to achieve said goal.

SKT|count nimbolo.title: Nimbolo
SKT|count nimbolo.intro: Burruld, also known by the name Count Nimbolo, was a cloud giant and master of a cloud castle in the late 15th century DR.
